name: konstruct
description: An ontology of your data stack (entities, measures, definitions and relationships) with column-level lineage checked against the warehouse, for dbt, SQL, Airflow and Dagster: skills for safe changes, data reviews, reconciling numbers, writing correct queries and semantic layer exports, slash commands, a data-reviewer subagent, the Konstruct MCP server and a hook that runs konstruct gate after SQL and dbt YAML edits.
